summary: Static backend-only validation of the Shoonya cross-origin OAuth context-recovery fix (new oauth-pending.store.ts + shoonya.controller.ts fallback). Executed per E1 instructions from /app: (1) `corepack pnpm --filter @cts/api typecheck` -> exit 0; (2) `corepack pnpm --filter @cts/api build` -> success; (3) `node backend/tests/shoonya_cross_origin_recovery_harness.cjs` -> 8 passed, 0 failed; (4) `node backend/tests/shoonya_callback_context_harness.cjs` -> 10/10 ALL PASS (including the 'Shoonya controller no longer uses the in-memory state map' assertion); (5) `node backend/tests/shoonya_oauth_harness.cjs` -> 9/9 ALL PASS; (6) all 18 backend/tests/*.cjs harnesses independently re-run -> ALL GREEN (Fyers isolation/reconnect/order/placement, Upstox redirect env, Zerodha follower/order/copy-product, instrument translation, integrity dedupe, manual search/trade/status/trace, follower payload regression). Code review of oauth-pending.store.ts + shoonya.controller.ts confirms: recovery order is (1) state param, (2) cookie, (3) pending-store fallback; fallback is single-use (recoverLatestPendingOAuth deletes the entry); latest-wins (createdAt comparison in the loop); broker-scoped (value.broker !== broker skip); TTL 10min with purgeExpired on every op; same-origin cookie/state paths clear stale SHOONYA pending after successful non-fallback recovery via clearPendingOAuth('SHOONYA'); no change to authorize URL, GenAcsTok checksum, token exchange, adapter, DB schema, or other broker controllers. A live browser OAuth round-trip CANNOT be executed here (no live Shoonya account, env forbids network) — the .cjs cross-origin harness reproduces the exact condition (no state + no cookie) logically against the compiled recovery expression.
critical_code_review_comments: oauth-pending.store.ts: TTL purge on every save/recover call is O(n); fine for expected volume (few concurrent logins) but note for future scale.
recoverLatestPendingOAuth iterates the whole map to find latest — correct and single-use via delete; broker isolation via value.broker !== broker skip is verified by the harness.

shoonya.controller.ts clears stale pending on non-fallback success via clearPendingOAuth('SHOONYA') — prevents a later context-less callback from picking up a stale entry from an earlier same-origin login; correctly gated so the fallback path (which already consumed its entry) doesn't call it redundantly.
No modification to authorize URL, checksum, token exchange, DB schema, adapters, or other brokers — scope respected.

In-memory store is process-resident: a process restart mid-OAuth (rare, seconds-long flow) forces a user retry — documented in the module header; acceptable for single-instance API deployment. If scaled horizontally later, this needs Redis/DB backing.
test_credentials: N/A — no live broker/DB/server. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cross-origin recovery fix is landed and verified statically. The new module /app/apps/api/src/brokers/oauth-pending.store.ts provides savePendingOAuth/recoverLatestPendingOAuth/clearPendingOAuth/_pendingOAuthSize (in-memory, 10min TTL, single-use, broker-scoped). The Shoonya controller /login now calls savePendingOAuth alongside the existing cookie/state, and /callback recovers via state -> cookie -> pending-store fallback. Live browser round-trip was NOT executed (env constraint); verification is purely static + harness-based per the review request. If a future agent needs to reproduce the fix in a live env, it must simulate a genuinely cross-origin browser redirect (localhost:4000 login -> cts.investwithdimple.com callback with no state, no cookie) — the .cjs harness already models this deterministically.
rca of the issue: RCA: Shoonya's OAuth authorize call does not echo the `state` param, and Shoonya's PORTAL-registered callback URL is on a different origin than the API origin the frontend points at (localhost:4000 vs cts.investwithdimple.com). Cookies set by /login on the API origin are not sent to the different callback origin, so BOTH recovery channels (state param + cts_oauth_state cookie) are empty at the callback and tradingAccountId cannot be recovered -> 'Reconnect context missing'. Fix (verified): keep the reconnect context in a server-side in-memory pending store on the API process itself; a cross-origin BROWSER redirect does not change which API instance serves the callback, so the entry survives. The controller falls back to recoverLatestPendingOAuth('SHOONYA') only when state and cookie are both empty, and single-use consumption prevents replay. Broker scoping prevents leakage between SHOONYA and FYERS. Reproduction (harness): shoonya_cross_origin_recovery_harness.cjs simulates login on origin-A + callback on origin-B with no state/cookie, and asserts tradingAccountId is recovered, single-use, latest-wins, and isolated per broker. All 8 checks pass. Mitigation: shipped as code — no user/portal action needed.
